title: A Thing of Trust
reason: Single most-programmed dance in the corpus (20x, 14 callers) — a safe, broadly-known opener.

title: Butter
reason: Explicitly requested; also #2 overall (17x) and confirmed Becket formation from Caller's Box.

title: Heartbeat Contra
reason: #4 overall (15x, 14 callers) and petronella-forward — a good iconic-figure demo dance.

title: Airpants
reason: #5 overall (14x); simple, generic figures make it a good readable-at-a-glance demo dance.

title: Frederick Contra
reason: High frequency (13x) with a different choreographer voice; adds down-the-hall variety to the set.

title: The Judge
reason: Tied #6 (13x, 10 callers); Bob Isaacs is the single most-programmed choreographer in the whole corpus.

title: Simplicity Swing
reason: Solid mid-tier frequency (11x, 9 callers) from a well-represented choreographer not otherwise on this list.

title: Theory of Mind
reason: 11x with the widest caller spread at that count (10 callers) — a dance dancers everywhere already know.

title: You Can Get There From Here
reason: 11x; brings in a give-and-take and chain-star figure not otherwise represented in the set.

title: Zag It Back
reason: 11x, Becket, with a zig-zag figure — good visual variety for the simulator.

title: Diamond Allotrope
reason: Feature-rich showcase pick, still programmed 8x by 7 callers — not obscure despite the figure density.

title: Spring Break
reason: Second feature-rich showcase pick, 6x programmed, and yet another distinct choreographer.
